title: The Tortoise Table — Dill (Dill Weed)
summary: Feed in Moderation. The dedicated entry reports no known hazards and notes high calcium, but says evidence of suitability for tortoises is insufficient for unrestricted feeding. It recommends dill only as part of a wider varied diet and explicitly says not to feed the seeds.
limitations: General tortoise specialist guidance, not a Mediterranean Testudo or Ibera direct feeding trial.
Leaves/herb use must not be generalized to dill seeds; the source explicitly says not to feed the seeds.
Moderation guidance does not establish a captive feeding percentage or staple role.
